payload.authorization: 2026-09-15 user authorized a grouped-source component-novelty audit and auxiliary structural-subgoal conversion checks before selecting a compositional generator
payload.scientific_problem: Determine whether held T4 structural subgoals are novel combinations of familiar address-free components or contain component-level support gaps.
payload.primary_output: Grouped-source coverage, novelty and transfer-precision measurements for frozen structural-subgoal component families, plus read-only conversion coverage for remaining Full-146 programs and the PMO dependency-region corpus.
payload.central_claim_under_test: Whole-patch template failure may be recoverable by a compositional generator only to the extent that held patch components transfer across source groups or are supported by compatible auxiliary transformation data.
payload.evaluation_setting: Three predeclared whole-source folds over 77 T4 teacher routes, 15 source groups and 147 structural subgoal instances, with all fold vocabularies derived from training sources only.

component_families.source_region_motif: address-free input-region graph with element, source degree and source bond order
component_families.target_topology: address-free target graph over surviving source roles and created roles with role type and unlabeled connectivity
component_families.atom_attributes: multiset of persistent before-to-after atom-state transitions, deletions and created atom states
component_families.bond_attributes: multiset of input bond-order transitions and target input-output or output-output bond orders
component_families.attachment_pattern: address-free source-to-created target attachment graph with role type, local degree and bond order
component_families.dependency_motif: address-free directed primitive dependency graph induced by created-handle and cycle open-close dependencies within the structural region
component_families.source_graphlets_up_to_3: connected source-region graphlets with one to three vertices and source atom and bond attributes
component_families.target_topology_graphlets_up_to_3: connected target-patch graphlets with one to three vertices, input-or-output role type and topology but no atom or bond attributes
component_families.atom_attribute_tokens: individual persistent before-to-after atom transitions, deletions and created atom-state tokens
component_families.bond_attribute_tokens: individual input bond transitions and target input-output or output-output bond-order tokens
component_families.attachment_edge_tokens: individual source-to-created attachment motifs, plus an explicit no-created-attachment token
component_families.dependency_tokens: individual typed producer-consumer dependency motifs, plus an explicit no-dependency token
component_families.target_radius_1_fragments: rooted attributed target-patch neighborhoods of radius one with boundary degree retained
component_families.target_radius_2_fragments: rooted attributed target-patch neighborhoods of radius two with boundary degree retained
component_families.target_graphlets_up_to_3: connected attributed induced target-patch graphlets with one to three vertices

exact_equivalence.method: bucket by deterministic Weisfeiler-Lehman signature, then require exact node-and-edge-attributed graph isomorphism within each bucket

payload.prepublication_definition_revision: An unsealed implementation sanity preview showed that whole atom-transition multisets and whole dependency graphs remained bundled decisions. Preserve those strict metrics and add finer tokens or graphlets so the audit answers the requested component-level question. No authoritative result or architecture selection preceded this revision.

auxiliary_conversion.full_146_fold_rule: use only non-complete-route program applications whose origin source is in the T4 training fold
auxiliary_conversion.pmo_fold_rule: PMO records have no T4 source-group identity and remain separately labelled answer-known auxiliary supervision

payload.interpretation_limit: This audit selects no generator architecture and establishes no autonomous proposal, docking or IVG result.
